summary: Rentokil Initial plc filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent: current report on Form 8-K) announcing an agreement to sell US-based SOLitude Lake Management, LLC and its Vertex Aquatic Solutions division to Bain Capital. Total cash consideration is $230m on a cash-free, debt-free basis, with estimated net after-tax proceeds of about $180m. The deal requires Hart-Scott-Rodino clearance and is expected to complete by early Q4 2026; Goldman Sachs International is sole financial advisor and joint corporate broker. SOLitude posted FY2025 revenue of $112m and adjusted operating profit of $16m. Watch HSR timing and leverage paydown.
